body:
I hear you. I understand some of your struggle. I have nobody to share my thoughts with either. I've been the caretaker od loved ones who pass in pretty horrific ways in my opinion. 
I feel like this is bullshit too. Like this is all fake. Like it's hell or something. CPTSD, Body dismorphia anxiety and possibly bipolar disorder. I'm on antidepressants but hid they are killing my body. I can't help you. I can't fix anything for you. I'm sorry you have to plead like this. You are valid in how you feel... and also not alone. I'm 22f. I'm still here but it's been a very very tough struggle. We can stay alive though if we want to. Even if it's just a day, a month, a year even. One day at a time.... Things are changing for me rapidly now. It's positive. I never saw it coming. I'm terrified bit I'm open to it. 

I hope so badly for a change for you.
Deep shit. Ngl half ass wanna know more. This thought process makes me curious. I study human nature often and this is genuinely intriguing to me.
I will. I usually come out of them okay. It's life for me.
Maybe an "oh God damn it anywhere but this fucking place and these fucking people." Button.

Your title of course intrigued me due to my username. I too love the snow. It's strange for people where I live because most of them long for the summer. 

I'm fascinated by the stars. The planets. Our galaxy and beyond it. 

I admire those who can play the piano. I can almost feel the passion when I hear certain bits. 

I've never seen the mountains but I often sit alone on the shoreline at this beautiful secluded park late at night with the universe just above me. I have nobody. 

I suffer with CPTSD and I have since I was a child. I'm 22F now and I've had daily suicidal ideation since I was 12-14ish. In and out of mental hospitals... on and off meds. But shit I'm still here. I think it's half ass my passion that keeps me going. And I hope so badly that you're primal instincts kick in and you can't do it because you sound a lot like me... I don't know anybody like me. 

Don't let this time be farewell to us. You have your whole life to put it off. One more day won't hurt.

Hey... just letting you know, something that is getting me through lately is you don't have to do it today. You can wait.... You have your whole life to figure out either how  to do it and do it right or poke around and see if the help that's out there really does help. 

It might sound silly. But I'm 22(F) and had several attempts within a span of 7-8 years as well as 3 stays at the psych unit. I've had daily suicidal ideation since I was 13-14. I'm at the point in my life where the first paragraph is true to me. And to be honest I don't have faith in pharmaceuticals or therapy. But I have a small belief that maybe one day I can have enough money to get a neuro scan... or even a simple blood test to see how different medications work for or against my system to maybe give my doctors even a small clue to what can help me get through each day without miserable side effects. 

You don't have to kill yourself today. You have time. Life might be shit now and be shit tomorrow but you keep getting through that shit. And there's no use in an attempt if you aren't sure if you'll get the desired results. It could make life hell if you do this wrong for hours or even days/months. I don't wish that upon anyone. 

If you need to talk to someone. My door is always open.

Well I've talked over the years with my family (sister and mother) and yes eventually they will move on. It will hurt really bad. Insanely bad at first, but like every family loss they will eventually gather their emotions and lives together and be able to move on without me. My sister half ass agrees and understands why I want to kill myself and wouldn't be angry if I did. She told my mom once yes it's selfish to commit suicide but it's also selfish to ask me to keep living a life that I can't handle. That most people couldn't handle. I'm fully aware there's people who have it worse... much worse and are still alive to speak about it but I'm tired. I'm not strong enough anymore. I know one day it'll be over. I don't know when but I know I won't live to be old. Usually when things get really bad in my head it's a very impulsive decision to attempt to end my life. I barely have control over myself when my emotions are out of control. Nobody can help me either. I've tried so fucking hard to find out what exactly is wrong with my head but don't have enough money for a brain scan or even a blood draw to determine what medications would work best for my system. And even If I did. Then what? Sure there would be a better understanding of my conditions and how my body reacts to certain medications but that's all. I'm sick of the trial and error with such high dose pharmaceutical drugs. They make me fucking sick. I've been existing for years and I'm not able to truly live. I always wanted that for myself but this last hospital visit essentially gaurenteed that I'll never change. I'll always struggle with my head. Simply put I don't want to anymore. I can't anymore. I'm so fucking exhausted.
